properties.displayName: UAV S92 - SAR Target Coordinate Exfiltration (Outside AOI, Exfil Flow Log)
properties.description: UAVExfilFlow_CL 유출 흐름 로그에서 SAR/영상 표적좌표(TargetLat/TargetLon)가 AOI_Boundary_List에 등록된 모든 허가구역(AOI) 밖으로 전송되는 것을 탐지. 기존 UAVSarPayload_CL+UAVC4I_CL 개별 조인 방식(S17)을 통합 유출 흐름 테이블 단일 소스로 재구성 — 등록된 AOI 다건(mpd_recon/mpd_attack/mpd_escort)을 전수 대조해 하나도 매칭되지 않을 때만 트리거. MITRE: T1041 Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 15m;
let AOIZones = _GetWatchlist('AOI_Boundary_List')
    | project MinLat=toreal(MinLat), MaxLat=toreal(MaxLat), MinLon=toreal(MinLon), MaxLon=toreal(MaxLon);
UAVSarPayload_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where isnotnull(TargetLat) and isnotnull(TargetLon)
| extend JoinKey = 1
| join kind=inner (AOIZones | extend JoinKey = 1) on JoinKey
| summarize IsInAnyAOI = max(toint(TargetLat between (MinLat .. MaxLat) and TargetLon between (MinLon .. MaxLon)))
    by TimeGenerated, UAVId, FrameId, Resolution, SensorMode, SizeBytes, TargetLat, TargetLon
| where IsInAnyAOI == 0
| extend TriggerReason = strcat("SAR표적좌표_허가AOI외_유출_lat:", tostring(TargetLat), "_lon:", tostring(TargetLon))
| extend Severity = "High"
| project TimeGenerated, UAVId, FrameId, Resolution, SensorMode, SizeBytes, TargetLat, TargetLon, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S92 - SAR Target Coordinate Exfiltration - {{UAVId}}
